svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: LANGUAGES: Go, TypeScript, C++, SQL, Python, C. BACKEND: NestJS, Node.js, chi, Express, Prisma. DATA & QUEUES: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka / Redpanda, BullMQ, MongoDB. FRONTEND & GFX: React, Next.js, TanStack Query, Tailwind, OpenGL
